accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.
Quality Engineering, Cloudflare Platform, and Database Engineering remain active with their accepted ownership boundaries.
Mobile Engineering is not promoted as a top-level faculty at this checkpoint. Flutter and Android guidance is approved as a progressive reference pack under existing owners.

Software Development owns Flutter/Android implementation, architecture refactoring, plugin integration, and build/config code changes; Interface Design owns mobile UX/UI direction; Quality Engineering owns independent widget/integration/device acceptance; Release Engineering owns APK/AAB/signing/store promotion; Database Engineering owns local database semantics.
Framework/vendor recipes do not override coherent project-local architecture merely because an upstream example prefers a particular pattern such as MVVM or Repository.
Flutter/Android/AGP/Gradle/Kotlin/JDK/SDK/Play policy/plugin compatibility and tool-command facts are drift-sensitive and require current official documentation when material.
Build success, emulator success, integration-test success, representative physical-device behavior, and store acceptance are distinct evidence layers.
The Android first-party skill corpus provides a useful acquisition principle: prioritize evaluated model weaknesses instead of creating skills for areas already handled adequately.

The next capability audit is Observability/SRE, still reference-first until distinct ownership beyond Software Development, Release Engineering, Security Engineering, Quality Engineering, Cloudflare Platform, and Database Engineering is proven.
unresolved_risks: Framework and platform guidance changes quickly; stale toolchain details remain a risk if live-doc verification is skipped.
A shared reference pack can still become oversized if loaded for every mobile task; progressive disclosure remains mandatory.
Physical-device and OEM-sensitive behavior may escape emulator and CI coverage; evidence claims must remain scoped.
A distinct Mobile Engineering faculty may become justified later if repeated cross-platform lifecycle/device/store concerns prove they do not fit existing owners.

next_executable_step.action: Deep-audit observability/SRE methodology and high-signal first-party ecosystems for logs, metrics, traces, alerting, incident diagnosis, production health, service-level thinking, and post-incident learning. Define ownership against Software Development, Release Engineering, Security Engineering, Quality Engineering, Cloudflare Platform, Database Engineering, and Agent Engineering; remain reference-first unless a distinct recurring operational ownership layer is proven.
